select count(*) from users where created_at >= trunc(sysdate) and created_at < trunc(sysdate) + 1 and user_type!='ADMIN'
select count(*) from report where status='WAIT'
select count(*) from users where user_type='COMPANY' and status='INACTIVE'

select sum(p.total) as totals from pay p join pay_status ps on p.tid=ps.tid where (ps.status='완료' or ps.status='환불요청') and p.approved_at >= trunc(sysdate,'MM') and p.approved_at < add_months(trunc(sysdate,'MM'),1)

select sum(p.total) as totals from pay p join pay_status ps on p.tid=ps.tid where (ps.status='완료' or ps.status='환불요청') and p.approved_at >= add_months(trunc(sysdate,'MM'),-1) and p.approved_at < trunc(sysdate,'MM')
SELECT NVL(ROUND(AVG(p.total), 0), 0) AS avg_pay_amount FROM pay p JOIN pay_status ps ON p.tid = ps.tid WHERE ps.status = '완료'
select count(*) from pay_status where status='환불요청'

SELECT d.dt AS sales_date, TO_CHAR(d.dt, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') AS day_name, ROUND(NVL(SUM(p.total), 0) / 10000, 1) AS daily_revenue FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - (LEVEL - 1) AS dt FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) d LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT p.tid, p.total, p.approved_at FROM pay p JOIN pay_status ps ON p.tid = ps.tid WHERE ps.status = '완료' ) p ON TRUNC(p.approved_at) = d.dt GROUP BY d.dt ORDER BY d.dt ASC

SELECT mf.MINOR_FIELD_NM AS FIELD_NAME, COUNT(p.PAY_IDX) AS PAY_COUNT, SUM(p.TOTAL) AS TOTAL_SUM, ROUND(SUM(p.TOTAL) * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(p.TOTAL)) OVER(), 1) || '%' AS RATIO FROM PAY p JOIN PAY_STATUS ps ON p.TID = ps.TID JOIN CLASS c ON TO_NUMBER(p.PARTNER_ORDER_ID) = c.CLASS_IDX JOIN MINOR_FIELD mf ON c.MINOR_FIELD_IDX = mf.MINOR_FIELD_IDX WHERE ps.STATUS = '완료' AND p.PAY_TYPE = 'CLASS' GROUP BY mf.MINOR_FIELD_NM ORDER BY TOTAL_SUM DESC

SELECT p.pay_type AS PAY_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS COUNT, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(), 1) AS PERCENT FROM pay p JOIN pay_status ps ON p.tid = ps.tid WHERE ps.status = '완료' GROUP BY p.pay_type

select sum(p.total) as total from pay p join pay_status ps on p.tid=ps.tid join pay_cancel pc on ps.tid=pc.tid where ps.status='환불완료' and pc.canceled_at >= trunc(sysdate,'MM') and pc.canceled_at < add_months(trunc(sysdate,'MM'),1)

SELECT c.COACH_IDX, c.PHOTO, c.NICKNAME, c.MAIL, NVL(r.AVG_RATING, 0) AS AVG_RATING, c.TOKEN_BALANCE, u.CREATED_AT FROM COACH c JOIN USERS u ON c.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REVIEWEE_IDX, ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1) AS AVG_RATING FROM REVIEW_COACH GROUP BY REVIEWEE_IDX ) r ON c.USER_IDX = r.REVIEWEE_IDX ORDER BY c.COACH_IDX DESC

SELECT c.USER_IDX, c.COACH_IDX, c.NICKNAME, c.PHOTO, c.VIDEO, c.INTRO, r.RANK_NAME, mf_major.MAJOR_FIELD_CD AS MAJOR_FIELD_NAME, mf_minor.MINOR_FIELD_NM AS MINOR_FIELD_NAME, NVL(rv.AVG_RATING, 0) AS RATING, NVL(rv.REVIEW_COUNT, 0) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM COACH c JOIN USERS u ON c.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN RANK r ON c.POINT_SCORE BETWEEN r.MIN_SCORE AND r.MAX_SCORE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COACH_IDX, MIN(MINOR_FIELD_IDX) as MIN_FIELD_IDX FROM COACH_PROVIDE GROUP BY COACH_IDX ) cp_top ON c.COACH_IDX = cp_top.COACH_IDX LEFT JOIN MINOR_FIELD mf_minor ON cp_top.MIN_FIELD_IDX = mf_minor.MINOR_FIELD_IDX LEFT JOIN MAJOR_FIELD mf_major ON mf_minor.MAJOR_FIELD_IDX = mf_major.MAJOR_FIELD_IDX LEFT JOIN ( SELECT REVIEWEE_IDX, ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1) AS AVG_RATING, COUNT(REVIEW_COACH_IDX) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM REVIEW_COACH GROUP BY REVIEWEE_IDX ) rv ON c.USER_IDX = rv.REVIEWEE_IDX WHERE c.COACH_IDX = #{coach_idx}
SELECT h.TAGS FROM HASHTAG h JOIN USER_HASHTAG uh ON h.HASHTAG_IDX = uh.HASHTAG_IDX JOIN COACH c ON uh.USER_IDX = c.USER_IDX WHERE c.COACH_IDX = #{coach_idx}
